 Getty Images Gianluca Minchiotti Oct 16, 2026 11:58-07:00 Translated by Inter, Marotta: “Champions League? Always optimistic. Lautaro, injuries are part of the game”
 Inter L. Martinez Serie A Inter president: “Confidence in Malagò confirmed? I don’t talk about these things”
 Beppe Marotta , president of Inter , spoke at Regione Lombardia during the presentation of Alpha League, a Lega Calcio Serie A initiative involving schools. 
 The Italian champions' president said little, but his comments revealed his mood on the main issues of the past few hours. 
 After the home defeat to Bruges , he remained optimistic about the Champions League: " Optimistic despite Inter-Bruges? Optimism is part of my life ", reports FcInter1908 . 
 Lautaro Martinez's injury , a problem with his thigh flexors that will keep the Argentine out for a month, drew this response: " Injuries are part of the game ". 
 Finally, on football politics : " Has confidence in Malagò been reaffirmed? I don't talk about these things ".
